name: How can I tell if my home has polybutylene pipes?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my home has polybutylene pipes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Identifying polybutylene pipes often requires checking visible plumbing lines, such as near the water heater, main shut-off valve, or in unfinished basements. Polybutylene is typically gray or blue, though it can also be black, and usually has a dull finish. It often has the code 'PB2110' printed on it. Fittings associated with polybutylene can be plastic or copper. If you're unsure, it's best to consult with a professional plumber. Alpha-Plumbing Services can inspect your home in areas like Goodyear or Avondale to confirm the presence of polybutylene.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check for gray, blue, or black pipes with a dull finish, often marked 'PB2110', near your water heater or main shut-off. A professional can confirm.
